page.headline: The whole model fits on the card, so nothing needs to go to RAM; this is what offloading would give.

lines: 27.9 GB of RAM for the experts: 30.2 GB available now (of 33.6 GB), less 2.1 GB kept free for the system and the engine. Read when this plan was made: it changes with what else runs.

lines: An engine that pins its host memory copies at 28.3 GB/s here, against 11.5 GB/s from normal memory (both measured on this GPU).
Reading prompts with this setup copies nothing (every expert is on the card), so pinned copies would not change it.
Writing replies with this setup copies nothing after loading (every expert is in the card's cache), so pinned copies would not change it.
These are limits, not promises: llama.cpp copies from normal memory, and an engine with pinned copies still has to keep them busy.
